title: Appliance Rebates in Kingston 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Kingston appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings, with Utilities Kingston as distributor.
lead: Kingston has 57,835 households and 44% of them rent, so asking the landlord is often the first step in an appliance claim.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Kingston
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: With 44% of Kingston households renting, many fridges and ranges belong to the landlord. The program page does not say owners only, but the person who buys the new appliance is the one who uploads the receipt. A tenant who replaces a landlord's fridge is paying for property that stays behind.

Utilities Kingston supplies electricity and Kingston postal codes begin with K, which the Energy Affordability Program lists. Renters who hold the utility account can apply for its free fridge and freezer route if their income is under the limit.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a Kingston condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 44% of Kingston households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.
Fridges and freezers at no cost

The Energy Affordability Program lists energy-efficient refrigerators and freezers among the items that comprehensive support can provide, along with LED bulbs, dehumidifiers and window air conditioners. It does not list washers or dryers, and its saving kits include no major appliances. Income limits run from $48,220 for one person to $96,439 for four, and Kingston postal codes are among those it covers. Call 1-844-770-3148 to ask.
Buy new, then upload the receipt

Buy a new appliance from any retailer, then upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase. Used and refurbished units do not qualify. Keep the receipt, the model number and the delivery date together. Kingston households who buy during a sale should still confirm the model is on the list at the time they check out.

The program page asks for an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. A new fridge to go in a spare corner, or an induction range where the kitchen had no range, is not a replacement. If you are switching from gas to an electric appliance, the page does not say whether that counts, so ask the program before you buy. Kingston households that already cook on an electric range are the clearest fit for the induction rebate.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Can a Kingston tenant get a free fridge?
Under the Energy Affordability Program, if they hold the utility account and meet the income limit.
Does Utilities Kingston have an appliance rebate?
Can a landlord claim for many units?
The page states no per-household limit, but each claim needs its own receipt. Ask the program about multiple units.
